description: Returns an array of all logs matching a given filter object.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The transaction call object which contains the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: fromBlock
sub_parameters.description: The block number as a string in hexadecimal format or tags. The supported tag values include earliest for the earliest/genesis block, latest for the latest mined block, pending for the pending state/transactions, safe for the most recent secure block, and finalized for the most recent secure block accepted by more than 2/3 of validators. safe and finalized are only supported on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Arbitrum Nova, and Avalanche C-chain

sub_parameters.name: toBlock
sub_parameters.description: The block number as a string in hexadecimal format or tags. The supported tag values include earliest for the earliest/genesis block, latest for the latest mined block, pending for the pending state/transactions, safe for the most recent secure block, and finalized for the most recent secure block accepted by more than 2/3 of validators. safe and finalized are only supported on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Arbitrum Nova, and Avalanche C-chain

sub_parameters.name: address
sub_parameters.description: The contract address or a list of addresses from which logs should originate

sub_parameters.name: topics
sub_parameters.description: An array of DATA topics and also, the topics are order-dependent. Visit this official page to learn more about topics

sub_parameters.name: blockHash
sub_parameters.description: With the addition of EIP-234, blockHash is a new filter option that restricts the logs returned to the block number referenced in the blockHash. Using the blockHash field is equivalent to setting the fromBlock and toBlock to the block number the blockHash references. If blockHash is present in the filter criteria, neither fromBlock nor toBlock is allowed

array.description: An array of log objects, or an empty array if nothing has changed since last poll:

array.address.description: An address from which this log originated

array.topics.description: An array of zero to four 32 Bytes DATA of indexed log arguments. In Solidity, the first topic is the hash of the signature of the event (e.g. Deposit(address, bytes32, uint256)), except you declare the event with the anonymous specifier

array.data.description: It contains one or more 32 Bytes non-indexed arguments of the log

array.blockNumber.description: The block number where this log was in. null when it's a pending log

array.transactionHash.description: The hash of the transactions this log was created from. null when its a pending log

array.transactionIndex.description: The integer of the transaction's index position that the log was created from. null when it's a pending log

array.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this log was in. null when it's a pending log

array.logIndex.description: The integer of the log index position in the block. null when it's a pending log

array.removed.description: It is true when the log was removed due to a chain reorganization, and false if it's a valid log
